inventory.method: Deterministic full-corpus inventory: enumerate every pinned source example and classify non-support entries by exact source-section text; overlapping entries retain the hand-audited support behavior.
inventory.limitations: This catalog proves pinned source coverage and citation linkage only. Source-section classifications are not semantic equivalence judgments; the 19-entry support catalog remains the hand-audited acceptability ledger.
